about: Manufacturers that opened, expanded or modernized in Macon-Bibb since 2015, and plants announced but not yet open (status 'coming'). Shown on the homepage's Industries title slide (js/growth-intro-map.js): each rises on the map in its first year, and hovering (or tapping) it shows its milestones. Jobs are as announced or as last reported, not counted. Each pin is checked against a physical address ('address'; 'located' says how): street numbers are geocoded with OpenStreetMap, and where the geocoder doesn't know a plant's private road, the plant's own building outline in OpenStreetMap is used. ArcelorMittal's site has no street number yet, so it sits at the end of Airport South Drive, where reports place it; First Quality Packaging Solutions sits on the Industrial Highway building that matches its reported size. Pins are close, not survey-exact. Not on the map: Agile Cold Storage (2024, refrigerated warehousing, not manufacturing). Also not on the map: Coca-Cola UNITED's Macon expansion (warehouse and distribution), Radius Recycling's aluminum separation plant and Complete Resources Management (recycling and waste), BrightFarms (greenhouse farming), Embraer, Stevens Aerospace and Dean Baldwin Painting (aircraft maintenance), and plants that opened before 2015, such as Aspen Products (announced 2013) and Johns Manville (1998).
